headline: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Round of 32
items: RESULT: Spain 3-0 Austria — Oyarzabal brace either side of Pedro Porro's strike ease Spain into the last 16
RESULT: Portugal 2-1 Croatia — Goncalo Ramos' 94th-minute header wins it after Ronaldo's leveller
RESULT: Belgium 3-2 Senegal (AET) — Tielemans' 125th-minute penalty completes a comeback from 2-0 down
RESULT: USA 2-0 Bosnia & Herzegovina — Balogun & Tillman fire the hosts into the last 16
RESULT: England 2-1 DR Congo — Harry Kane's brace (75', 86') sends England through
LIVE: Switzerland vs Algeria — Round of 32 finale under way in Vancouver (Embolo opened the scoring)
TODAY: Round of 32 concludes — Australia vs Egypt (2:00 PM ET), Argentina vs Cape Verde (6:00 PM ET), Colombia vs Ghana (9:30 PM ET)
NEXT: Round of 16 begins Sat — Canada vs Morocco; Mexico vs England (Sun); USA vs Belgium & Spain vs Portugal (Mon)
GOLDEN BOOT: Messi & Mbappe lead on 6 goals (Mbappe ahead on assists); Haaland & Kane close behind on 5
